name: TrackPM Software
description_en:
TrackPM combines project boards and task-level time recording with employee, attendance/leave, payroll, file and asset modules. Its current homepage positions the suite for Indian IT teams, with work records feeding further administrative processes. This profile focuses on the task-to-time workflow and the conditions around its additional modules.

The integration of those records is a product claim, not independent confirmation that every hour, attendance day or salary result is correct. A team should inspect the mapping, corrections and approval path before using reports for billing or payroll. Public marketing pages and documented AI controls were read; no tracker, account, salary calculation or external connection was tested.
description_zh:
TrackPM 把项目看板和任务级工时，与员工、考勤／休假、工资、文件及资产模块放在一起。当前官网面向印度 IT 团队，描述工作记录进入后续行政流程。本文聚焦任务到工时的路径，以及附加模块的使用条件。

记录相互连接是产品主张，不是对每个工时、考勤日或工资结果正确性的独立确认。把报告用于计费或工资前，应检查映射、修正与审批路径。本次实读了公开营销页及 AI 控制说明，没有测试跟踪客户端、账户、工资计算或外部连接。

sections.title_en: Follow one task from board to a time entry
sections.title_zh: 从看板跟踪一项任务到工时记录
sections.en:
For a hypothetical login defect, record the affected project, reproduction context, assignee and acceptance criteria, then move the task through a small board workflow. TrackPM describes configurable Kanban stages and Scrum/backlog support.

Inspect whether a time entry points to the intended project and task rather than relying on similar names. A completed board card should mean the team’s acceptance criteria have passed, not merely that a timer stopped. Request a demonstration of one reassignment and a reopened task before assuming their reports retain the intended history. These are evaluation checks; no defect, sprint or time entry was created.
sections.zh:
假设处理登录缺陷，可以记录项目、复现背景、负责人及验收条件，再沿小型看板流程移动。TrackPM 说明支持可配置 Kanban 阶段和 Scrum／待办。

应检查工时是否指向正确项目及任务，不能只看相似名称。看板完成应表示团队验收通过，而不只是计时器停止。假设报告保留预期历史前，可要求演示一次重新分派与任务重开。这些是评估检查，本次没有创建缺陷、冲刺或工时。

sections.title_en: Check how a correction changes the record
sections.title_zh: 检查修正如何改变记录
sections.en:
The Edit Time page describes manual/timer logging, authorized manager edits and audit records. The general tracker page emphasizes automatic app/site/task tracking and also says “No manual log entries,” so manual-entry availability should be confirmed for the actual client and role.

Use a deliberately identified test interval in a demonstration, correct its project or duration, and inspect before/after values and who made the change. Do not infer an immutable audit trail from a marketing label alone. Periodic screenshots and active/idle indicators provide activity observations, not proof of a deliverable’s correctness, effort quality or the legal suitability of monitoring.
sections.zh:
Edit Time 页面描述手动／计时记录、获授权经理编辑和审计记录；通用跟踪页则强调自动记录应用／网站／任务，并写有“No manual log entries”，因此实际客户端及角色能否手工记录需确认。

演示可以使用标识清楚的测试时段，修正项目或时长，再检查前后值及修改者。不能只凭营销标签推断不可变审计记录。定期截图和活跃／空闲指标是活动观察，不是交付正确、投入质量或监控适法性的证明。

sections.title_en: Verify the review path before using payroll outputs
sections.title_zh: 使用工资输出前验证复核路径
sections.en:
The Time Approval page describes employee logs, manager review, approval/rejection, reporting and export. It also names multi-level rules, pending notifications and bulk approval. It does not provide enough operational detail to establish who can bypass review, how a rejected entry returns or what happens after payroll is generated.

For a pilot, inspect one accepted entry and one rejected correction, then compare the resulting report with the known inputs. Treat attendance, leave and payroll calculations as separate validation needs. The homepage’s Indian payroll labels identify intended scope; they do not certify current statutory rates, filings or compliance for an employer. No payroll or legal calculation was performed.
sections.zh:
Time Approval 页面描述员工记录、经理复核、批准／拒绝、报告和导出，也列出多级规则、待批通知及批量审批。但操作细节不足以确立谁能绕过复核、拒绝条目如何返回，或生成工资后怎样处理。

试点应检查一条接受记录和一次拒绝后的修正，再将报告与已知输入比较。考勤、休假和工资计算需分别验证。首页的印度工资标签只说明目标范围，不能认证雇主当前法定费率、申报或合规。本次未执行工资或法律计算。

sections.title_en: In-app confirmation is different from MCP access
sections.title_zh: 应用内确认与 MCP 访问不同
sections.en:
Ask TrackPM proposes a change for confirmation. Its guide says proposals expire after fifteen minutes, run at most once and are canceled by another message, with role checks repeated at execution. Staff, admins and account owners have different scopes.

AI Agent Access instead issues a personal key and server URL for a compatible MCP client. The key acts within its owner’s role; the comparison table describes changes made by the agent, so do not assume every MCP write has the in-app confirmation screen. Check the intended workspace, role and stored result in a minimal pilot. Built-in allowances and a company-provided model key differ from the external assistant’s subscription cost. Exact limits and recovery were not tested; no key was generated.
sections.zh:
Ask TrackPM 先提出修改再确认。指南称提案十五分钟过期、最多执行一次，发送其他消息会取消，并在执行时重新检查角色。员工、管理员和账户所有者的范围不同。

AI Agent Access 则为兼容 MCP 客户端生成个人 key 和服务器 URL，按 key 所有者角色执行；对比表说明由代理修改，因此不能假设每次 MCP 写入都有应用内确认屏幕。最小试点应检查目标工作区、角色及存储结果。内置额度、公司自备模型 key 与外部助手订阅成本不同。本次未测试具体上限或恢复，没有生成 key。

sections.title_en: Free modules do not remove the platform-fee question
sections.title_zh: 免费模块不能消除平台费问题
sections.en:
The current pricing page labels PM and time tracking free but lists a $5 monthly platform fee, $1/user office management, $0.25 asset charge and $0.35/GB storage. Its FAQ separately lists User Access and Office Management at $1/user each and says the first GB is free. Those lines need clarification before totaling a bill. The homepage says INR monthly while the table uses dollar signs without clarifying the currency.

The thirty-day trial permits two users and 1 GB. Monthly billing is described as invoiced on the first and due by the fifth, while the older terms describe advance subscriptions. Confirm currency, applicable base/user charges, storage and payment timing. No normalized total or standalone permanently free account is asserted.
sections.zh:
当前定价页把项目管理和工时列为免费，同时列出标作每月 $5 的平台费、每用户 $1 的办公管理费、$0.25 资产费和每 GB $0.35 存储。FAQ 又把 User Access 和 Office Management 各列为每用户 $1，并称首 GB 免费。这些行需澄清后才能合计。首页称按 INR 月付，表格却用 $ 符号且未明确币种。

三十天试用允许两位用户及 1 GB。月度付款被描述为每月一日出账、五日到期，旧条款则描述预先订阅。应确认币种、适用基础／用户费用、存储和付款时间。本档案不提供归一化总价，也不确认独立永久免费账户。

sections.title_en: Resolve public-document gaps before depending on the suite
sections.title_zh: 依赖整套系统前解决公开资料缺口
sections.en:
The terms retain vendor software rights and grant a limited service-use license, rather than an open-source or self-hosting grant. The public text includes template remnants such as “[Your Company]” and unrelated filler. It does not establish a complete account-specific retention, refund, export or recovery agreement. The help hub’s FAQ body returned a loading placeholder.

Shortlist the product when the integrated India-focused task/time/administration scope matches the business, then request concrete demonstrations and a current contract for the needed modules. Preserve a usable export and test a failure path before relying on it as the sole work or payroll record. Vendor testimonials, accuracy claims and productivity percentages were not treated as independent results.
sections.zh:
条款保留厂商软件权利，授予有限服务使用许可，不是开源或自托管授权。公开文本包含“[Your Company]”等模板残留和无关占位段落，不能确立完整的账户保留、退款、导出或恢复约定。帮助中心 FAQ 正文仅返回加载占位。

当面向印度的任务／工时／行政一体范围符合业务时，可以列入候选，再索取所需模块的具体演示和当前合同。把它作为唯一工作或工资记录前，应保留可用导出并测试失败路径。厂商评价、准确性主张和生产力百分比均未当作独立结果。
